title: Why Do Bats Hang Upside Down? 🦇 #Shorts
description:
Unlike birds, bats can't take off from the ground — their wings are too weak for a standing start and their legs too small to run, so they hang upside down ready to fall into flight. Special foot tendons lock their toes shut, so hanging costs them zero effort. 🦇
OTIS answers the wildest animal questions with real science.
